opennyai_summary.PREAMBLE:
Gundrati Chandra Sekhar vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 23
January, 2020
Author: J. Uma Devi
Bench: J. Uma Devi
The Hon'Ble Ms. Justice J. Uma Devi
Criminal Petition No.289 Of 2020
Order:
This criminal petition is filed by the petitioner seeking to quash the proceedings in C.C.No.307 of 2018, on the file of the Court of the Additional Judicial Magistrate of the First Class, Gudur registered for the offence under Section 353 IPC and Section 58 of Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006 (for short, "the Act").
opennyai_summary.decision:
When the matter is taken up for hearing, it is brought to the notice of this Court that in a Criminal Petition No.6205 of 2019 filed by the petitioner therein, this Court passed an order dated 22.10.2019, quashing the proceedings in Crime No.248 of 2019, on the file of the Buchireddypalem Police Station, S.P.S.R. Nellore District registered for the offences under Section 272, 273, 328 IPC and Section 59(i) of the Act.
Following the order passed in the aforementioned criminal petition and for the reasons recorded therein, this criminal petition is allowed quashing the proceedings in C.C.No.307 of 2018, on the file of the Court of the Additional Judicial Magistrate of the First Class, Gudur registered for the offence under Section 353 IPC and Section 58 of the Act as against the petitioner.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any pending, shall also stand closed in consequence.
